hud.safeZoneSubtitle: Safe from all hazards. Nothing to interact with here — return inward to continue.
taskEnding.peace_need: My mind feels calm and quiet at last... Now I can go to the rabbit hole at the center to escape!
taskEnding.peace_pain: The illusion has stopped running away. The true rabbit hole is waiting right here at the center. Time to escape!
taskEnding.wonder_need: Found it! The true key is shining in the earth - my wonder was rewarded after all! Now I can head to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.wonder_pain: There you are, finally resting at the center! No more running away from disappointment... The rabbit hole is open right beside us. It is time to escape.
taskEnding.support_need: I caught up to you! I don't have to carry this heavy burden alone anymore. Together, let's head to the rabbit hole at the center and escape!
taskEnding.support_pain: There you are! You are safe, and I am not trapped in solitude anymore. Come, let's make our way to the rabbit hole at the center and escape!
taskEnding.certainty_need: The colors have aligned in perfect order! The mist of doubt has parted, and certainty is restored. Now I can proceed to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.certainty_pain: The little bird is safely nestled in its home, warm and protected. Certainty returns to the forest... Now I can escape through the rabbit hole at the center.
taskEnding.hope_need: The blighted flora are purged! Light and life are returning to the soil, and hope is restored. Now I can head to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.hope_pain: The blaze is extinguished... the smoke is clearing and the grove is saved from destruction. Now I can proceed to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.attention_need: I listened closely and honored the forest's sacred call! Harmony is restored to the woods. Now I can make my way to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.attention_pain: Every cage is unlocked! The air is filled with the joy of free wings, and confinement is broken. I am ready to head to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.privacy_need: The intrusions have been cleansed! The sacred forest's borders and sovereignty are restored. The path is clear—time to head to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.privacy_pain: The creeping threats have been banished from the threshold! Our sanctuary is defended and peaceful once again. Now I can step into the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
taskEnding.default: The conflict is resolved and the forest is at peace! I can now come to the rabbit hole at the center to escape.
heroThought.initial_peace_need: Can a weary mind ever find peace in this place? I must gather the 5 daisies to quiet my thoughts...
heroThought.initial_peace_pain: Everything here feels so hollow and dull... I need to find the rabbit hole and escape this suffocating dissatisfaction before it drowns me.
heroThought.initial_wonder_need: So many mysterious burrows in the earth... which one holds the true key to escape? I must explore them all.
heroThought.initial_wonder_pain: I need to find the White Rabbit waiting at the center of the forest...
heroThought.initial_support_need: I can't carry this burden alone. I need someone by my side... Wait, there they are! Don't run from me, wait!
heroThought.initial_support_pain: The silence is deafening. This crushing loneliness is eating away at my heart... Where are you hiding? Please, let me find you before time runs out!
heroThought.initial_certainty_need: So much uncertainty! I need to find the true glowing marking and follow its color order, but how can I know which path is real in this blinding mist?
heroThought.initial_certainty_pain: That poor bird is stranded and shivering... Even in perpetual doubt, there has to be hope. I must guide it back to its nest near the center.
heroThought.initial_hope_need: I need to save the forest from the infection to restore hope! Hover the cursor over these 3 infected flora for 5 seconds to purge their blight.
heroThought.initial_hope_pain: The flames are spreading so fast! If I lose focus for even a second, the entire grove will burn to cinder. I must put out every fire!
heroThought.initial_attention_need: I must pay attention to the forst's call... I need to inspect the sacred marking at the center and follow its colors.
heroThought.initial_attention_pain: Helpless and confined, just like my own trapped thoughts... I must break the locks and set all 5 caged birds free from their imprisonment.
heroThought.initial_privacy_need: Intrusions everywhere! The sacred forest is being violated. I must cleanse these 8 illness stains to reclaim the forest's sovereignty.
heroThought.initial_privacy_pain: Those illness stains threaten to destroy the rabbit hole! I cannot let them cause such imbalance. I must banish all creeping threats!
heroThought.relic_hint_attempt_2: Their words cut right to my soul... but I refuse to break. I must search the woods for a hint to expose their flawed conviction!
heroThought.relic_hint_attempt_3: The white rabbit's resolve is suffocating. I cannot falter now - I need to unearth find more clues hidden in the forest to steady my resolve!
heroThought.relic_hint_attempt_4: This is the final threshold. To challenge their ancient despair and end this cycle, I must recover one more secret from the forest!
heroThought.caterpillar_absorbed_hit: Gah! The caterpillar absorbed the deadly strike for me... I have to be more careful!
heroThought.death_instant: The darkness is too heavy... I let the despair win. But perhaps, with a fresh conviction, I can try again...
heroThought.take_damage: Ugh! The forest's perils are unforgiving... My body aches. I can't survive many more wounds like that.
heroThought.death_hearts_zero: My heart feels so heavy... the despair has swallowed me. But the story isn't over yet...
heroThought.caterpillar_caught: Caught you! I could sacrifice this caterpillar to protect myself.
heroThought.fire_breached_center: No! The flames have breached the sacred center! Everything is burning—I must extinguish the fire before all is lost!
heroThought.creeping_illness_breach: They've reached the threshold! The rabbit hole is under siege - get back, you abominations!
heroThought.collected_special_item: I hold the {item} in my hands... Its truth hums within me. Now I have the strength to confront the rabbit again.
heroThought.peace_daisy_progress: A glimmer of peace... ({progress}/{max}) daisies collected. Keep searching!
heroThought.fire_extinguished_progress: One fire out! But the flames are still crackling—{remaining} more to extinguish!
heroThought.caged_birds_all_freed: Every cage is open! Listen to their wings beating against the sky... My spirit feels lighter. I am ready to confront the rabbit at the center.
heroThought.caged_bird_freed_progress: Fly free! Another soul liberated from captivity ({progress}/{max}). I must reach the others!
heroThought.illness_stain_cleansed_progr: The soil breathes again. Another stain wiped clean ({progress}/{max}). I will reclaim this whole forest.
heroThought.creeping_illness_banished_pr: Vanished into dust! The rabbit hole is safer now ({progress}/{max}). Keep pressing on!
heroThought.wonder_key_found: I found it! A cold brass key resting in the loam... this Wonder was worthwhile after all! Now I can escape through the rabbit hole at the center.
heroThought.wonder_burrow_empty: Just empty roots and dry dirt here... But I refuse to give up. The truth must be hidden in another burrow.
heroThought.mushroom_color_match: The colors align! Found {color}... Which color should come next?
heroThought.mushroom_color_wrong: No... that wasn't the right color! The pattern broke and slipped away.
heroThought.flora_pollen_warning: Cough... the sickening pollen is choking the air! Keep distance and hover the cursor over the flora to purge it!
heroThought.flora_cleansing_channel: Channeling willpower to cleanse the blight... {secLeft}s remaining!
heroThought.flora_purged_progress: Infected flora purged! Hope returns to the forest ({progress}/{max}).
heroThought.flora_strike_progress: Purging the blight... it's weakening! Just a few more strikes!
heroThought.real_rabbit_hole_opened: Wait - the real rabbit hole has opened up back at the center! I have to hurry back!
heroThought.hole_dissolved_first: It dissolved right before my eyes?! what Dissatisfaction... No, I won't let it deceive me. Keep searching!
heroThought.hole_dissolved_second: Another cruel illusion! It vanished again... But the real exit must exist. I must press on!
heroThought.hole_shimmering_fading: It's shimmering and fading away! Quick, reach it before it disappears!
heroThought.rabbit_fleeing: Wait! Where are you going? Come back! Such dissapointment!
heroThought.rabbit_fleeing_short: Wait! Where are you going? Come back!
heroThought.primal_distant_cold: The White Rabbit's gaze is distant and cold. They won't let me pass for now.
heroThought.primal_needs_relic: Their conviction is an impenetrable fortress... I cannot break through with words alone. I must find the {item} in the woods!
heroThought.wrong_password: That password was wrong... doubt is gnawing at my resolve. How can I know what is true in this maze?

matrix.step4.unfitDesc: The flaw is within us — humans are inherently broken.

needDefinitions.peace: The need to get nutrients in a digestible manner.
needDefinitions.wonder: The need to examine possibilities deeply.
needDefinitions.support: The need to get help upon failure.
needDefinitions.certainty: The need to trust the information given to us.
needDefinitions.hope: The need to believe we will prevail.
needDefinitions.attention: The need for our plans to bare fruit.
needDefinitions.privacy: The need for personal space where we have sovereignty.
needDefinitions.dissatisfaction: The pain in lack of response to stimuli.
needDefinitions.disappointment: The pain in finding a gap between expectation and reality.
needDefinitions.loneliness: The pain in lack of comrades to our goals.
needDefinitions.uncertainty: The pain in loss of certainty.
needDefinitions.imprisonment: The pain in disability to reach our goals.
needDefinitions.change: The pain in loss of stability.
simulation.coreBelief.unallowed: the world will never allow humans to {needGoal}
simulation.coreBelief.unfit: humans are too inherently flawed to {needGoal}
simulation.outcomeBelief.granted: any attempt to pursue it is doomed to inevitable failure
simulation.outcomeBelief.validated: there is no validation to even try, making any wait endless and futile
simulation.pressureContext.highSocial: intense judgment and scrutiny from others
simulation.initialArgument:
I stand before you as your {agentRole}. You cannot pass beyond this threshold.

I believe that {coreBelief} under {pressureContext}—{outcomeBelief}. In my eyes, this conclusion is absolute.

If you wish to cross, you must debate me and challenge my conviction. Argue your case with reason—why should I let you pass?
simulation.itemPresentation.mirror: *You present the Shattered Mirror of the Past*
simulation.itemPresentation.emblem: *You present the Emblem of the Defiant*
simulation.barrierBroken: ...Your logic... it holds. The barrier is broken.
simulation.defaultVictorySummary: Your logic prevailed. The negative faith is broken.
simulation.gameOverDespair: [System Message]: You have failed to win the debate after the final attempt. Despair claims you...
simulation.attemptEnded: [System Message]: This attempt has ended. You failed to break The White Rabbit's faith. Return to the forest and find the "{nextItemName}" to unlock the next debate.
simulation.chatClosed: [System Message]: You closed the chat. This attempt has ended. Seek and collect the "{nextItemName}" in the forest to continue.
simulation.errorSpecialStory: [System Error]: Failed to trigger special story.
simulation.errorUnknown: [System Error]: Unknown error. Please check API keys.
